issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double, but the solution implements getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() returning int. This return-type mismatch can confuse students about the expected signature and behavior (should allow fractional students-per-tutor values) and may cause test or grading mismatches if the tests expect a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the return type with the UML/specification: change the method signature to public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() and compute using floating-point division (for example: return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors();). Update the template TODO to indicate the double return type so students implement the correct signature.
